---
title: "R output"
---

The R counterpart of `py-outputs.qmd`. Auto-printed objects are rendered
according to their type; `print()` and `cat()` stay console text.

## Data frames

```{r}
mtcars[1:6, 1:6]
```

```{r}
print(mtcars[1:6, 1:6])
```

```{r}
iris
```

```{r}
library(tibble)
tib <- tibble(
  name = c("Ada", "Grace", "Katherine", NA),
  born = c(1815L, 1906L, 1918L, NA),
  score = c(9.5, -1.25, 7, NA),
  when = as.Date(c("2026-01-01", "2026-02-15", NA, "2026-04-30"))
)
tib
```

```{r}
nycflights13::flights
```

```{r}
wide <- as.data.frame(matrix(1:60, nrow = 3, dimnames = list(NULL, paste0("v", 1:20))))
wide
```

```{r}
tibble(id = 1:2, items = list(1:3, letters[1:2]))
```

```{r}
data.table::as.data.table(head(airquality))
```

Grouped summaries, the most common dplyr output:

```{r}
#| message: false
library(dplyr)
mtcars |>
  group_by(cyl) |>
  summarise(n = n(), mpg = mean(mpg), hp = max(hp))
```

## Matrices

```{r}
matrix(1:6, nrow = 2)
```

```{r}
set.seed(1)
round(matrix(rnorm(16), 4), 3)
```

```{r}
matrix(1:400, 20)
```

```{r}
cor(mtcars[, 1:4])
```

Non-numeric matrices and `print()` stay console text:

```{r}
matrix(letters[1:6], 2)
```

```{r}
print(matrix(1:4, 2))
```

## Vectors, factors, tables, models

```{r}
1:30
```

```{r}
c(a = 1.5, b = -2, c = NA)
```

```{r}
factor(c("lo", "hi", "lo", "mid"), levels = c("lo", "mid", "hi"))
```

```{r}
table(mtcars$cyl, mtcars$gear)
```

```{r}
summary(lm(mpg ~ wt + hp, data = mtcars))
```

```{r}
str(iris)
```

```{r}
list(a = 1, b = "two", c = list(d = 3))
```

## Loops

```{r}
for (i in 1:5) cat(sprintf("iter %d  value=%.3f\n", i, 1 / i))
```

## Messages, warnings, errors

```{r}
message("a message")
warning("a warning")
1 + 1
```

```{r}
stop("an error")
```

## r4ds style: collapsed output with `#>`

```{r}
#| collapse: true
#| comment: "#>"
x <- c(1, 4, 9)
sqrt(x)
head(mtcars, 3)
```

## Plots

```{r}
plot(mtcars$wt, mtcars$mpg, xlab = "weight", ylab = "mpg")
```

```{r}
library(ggplot2)
ggplot(mtcars, aes(wt, mpg, colour = factor(cyl))) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", formula = y ~ x, se = FALSE)
```
